title: cell.json
description: All 70 technique×form cells (contracts.md §2.2). `classicalLabels` are display-only and are never read by a rule. `edicts` seeds a starting ruleset; a cell may not carry both an interdiction and a dispensation (contracts.md §1.1).

excludes.description: Anti-requisites: bodies of magic this cell's excludes, checked against a MAGE's held set and never the universe's (vision.md §4b). Symmetric — both halves must be authored, with the same reason and the same resolution — because §4b derives symmetry from the reason rather than asserting it alongside: an exclusion whose reason does not run both ways is not yet an exclusion. `intellego` may not appear on either side; it is the grid's perception trunk, so excluding it costs a mage two-thirds of the grid rather than a school.

reason.description: Why the two exclude one another. Load-bearing rather than decorative: §4b makes symmetry follow from the reason, so a reason that does not run both ways is the signal that the pair is not yet an exclusion.

resolution.description: What happens when a mage who holds one acquires the other. `refused` — the acquisition never happens. `destructive` — it succeeds and every instance of the excluded body of magic that mage holds is destroyed, which is a real loss and may take the universe's last copy. Authored per exclusion rather than fixed globally, because §4b makes each exclusion carry its own reason and the resolution follows the reason.
